text_block_list.text:
Tickets to a play, given to me by the 
hotel manager when I previously had dinner 
with members of the Mejiro family.

Today, I had come to watch that play, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"A greeting? Thanks for going out of your 
way."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
No. ...By the way, may I ask you about the 
other day's race?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
In that case, how about some black tea in 
the lobby? We still have time before the 
show begins♪

"...What a dazzling, magnificent place. 
Perhaps out of nervousness, it makes me 
feel restless, but—"
choice_data_list: (If I want to stand beside Ramonu...)

text_block_list.text:
Thinking that, I straightened my posture. 
My goal is to be like her that night we 
had dinner at the hotel—thrillingly cool.
choice_data_list: （ラモーヌの隣に立つなら……）
choice_data_list_en: (If I am to stand beside Ramonu...)

text_block_list.text:
However... surely just doing something 
like this won't grant me elegance like 
hers.
choice_data_list: (What else should I be careful about?)
(What else should I watch out for?)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
“—First, try relaxing your shoulders a 
little more!”
choice_data_list: （他は何に気をつければいいんだ？）
（他は何に気をつければいいんだろう？）
choice_data_list_en: (What else should I watch out for?)
(What else should I watch out for...?)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ I'm sorry. It was just written all 
over your face: "I want to become just 
like Ramonu-san."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Which is why, I have one more piece of 
advice for you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
To put it simply! —'Grace is born from 
composure', you know♪
choice_data_list: ...Elegance turns into composure?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. Take a closer look at Ramonu-san. 
What do you think she's doing?"
choice_data_list: ……気品が余裕に？

text_block_list.text:
"I'm just drinking black tea like normal," 
I started to reply—before suddenly 
realizing.
choice_data_list:
Are they... watching their 
surroundings...?

text_block_list.text:
Though she's only moving her eyes, it 
feels as though she's been quietly 
watching her surroundings the entire time.
choice_data_list: なんか、周りのこと見てる……？
choice_data_list_en: Are you paying attention to your surroundings...?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Looking around like that—
(CRASH!)

text_block_list.name: Theater Staff
text_block_list.text:
I-I am terribly sorry...! Are you hurt at 
all!? Did any shards or hot water get on 
you...!?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: No, not particularly.

text_block_list.name: Theater Staff
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry! Please forgive me...! I'll 
clean this right up... and then get you a 
new seat!

In that instant, a heavy tension fills the 
air. Everyone turned their eyes toward 
Mejiro Ramonu, waiting for her judgment... 
or so it seemed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
The only things that got wet were you and 
the floor.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: There is no need to make a fuss.

text_block_list.name: Theater Staff
text_block_list.text:
! ...My sincerest apologies once again. 
Thank you very much for your kind words. I 
will prepare your seats immediately.

...Swept up by Mejiro Ramonu's composure, 
the atmosphere in the lobby completely 
settled down.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
—By keeping track of the situation at all 
times, you can maintain your own pace no 
matter what happens.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That composure turns into poise, which 
gives birth to true grace. ...Isn't that 
right!
choice_data_list: I see...!

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"—The performance will begin shortly. 
Guests who are out of their seats, 
please..."
choice_data_list: なるほど……！

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look at the time! I must return to my 
seat... Please excuse me.

After the play concluded to thunderous 
applause, we moved over to the theater's 
salon lounge.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That opening solo was amazing! Your voice 
had such incredible reach, I could hardly 
believe you're a newcomer~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Maybe I'll come back to see 
them when the buds begin to open.

Watching the girls from the side as they 
discussed their impressions of the play, I 
decided to put into practice what I had 
just learned.
choice_data_list: (First, I need to check our surroundings—)

text_block_list.text:
—Just then, I saw a man approaching. He 
didn't seem like someone I knew, though.
choice_data_list: （まずは、周囲の状況を――）

text_block_list.name: Pompous Man
text_block_list.text:
Is it true that you are Mejiro 
Ramonu-kun's Trainer?
choice_data_list:
Yes, I am currently serving in that 
capacity.

text_block_list.name: Pompous Man
text_block_list.text:
Then allow me to say this. Be extremely 
careful in your guidance. Crushing her 
talent is something that must never—
choice_data_list: はい、務めさせていただいています
choice_data_list_en: Yes, I have the honor of serving in that role.

text_block_list.text:
Their tremendous momentum almost makes me 
flinch. No... I can't let them break my 
rhythm here. If I am to create an 
'opening'—
choice_data_list: Imitate Ramonu and smile.
Imitate Ramonu and stare intently.

text_block_list.name: Pompous Man
text_block_list.text:
!? ...No... well... you see. In other 
words... I had high hopes for her...
choice_data_list: ラモーヌを真似して、微笑む
ラモーヌを真似して、ジッと見つめる

text_block_list.name: Pompous Man
text_block_list.text:
...H-Hmph. I'll hold you to those words, 
then.
choice_data_list: 精一杯、務めさせていただきます
choice_data_list_en: I will perform my duties to the best of my ability.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: That is an appropriate response.
choice_data_list: （……き、緊張した～）

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
You're right. She seems surprisingly 
tough.

text_block_list.name: Pompous Man
text_block_list.text:
!? ...Wh-What is it? If you have something 
to say...
choice_data_list:
Thank you very much for your passionate 
support.

text_block_list.name: Pompous Man
text_block_list.text:
! A-As long as you understand. Though... 
perhaps I got a little too heated as well. 
My apologies.
choice_data_list: 熱い応援、ありがとうございます
choice_data_list_en: Thank you so much for your passionate support.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Snapping like that, how unusual.
choice_data_list: （『間』を作るって、こんな感じか？）
（『間』を作るって、こんな感じ？）
choice_data_list_en: (Is this what it's like to time a "pause"?)
(Is this what timing a "pause" feels like?)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Fufu, yep, yep! A perfect 100 points♪
